title: Model European opcode 39 registry poses
changes: Add a conditional typed source model for opcode-39 high-registry direct-job poses, retaining producer references and new index, sequence and decoded pixel data after prior-owner subtraction.
validation: Windows GNU build edty2_sx and Wine z2eftm1l passed exact EUR source and producer guards, reconstruction and JSON round-trip for 71 pairs, 6,960 index words, 410 sequences and 161 pixel blocks; the original task selected the correct actor after a nonmatching list node in a controlled context.
Static source plan c5fo5wt5 authenticates 2,301 disjoint new ranges and 91,712 source bytes; the existing normal-battle sprite-42 index root remains with its previous owner.
limitations: The model is conditional and not yet published or consumed at runtime. Original index-reader validation, ordinary use, other producer domains, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
